svg.title: Coherent and reference-assisted energy-domain receiver architectures
svg.desc: Two four-column diagrams compare coherent I/Q acquisition and reference-assisted energy detection. A common reference source feeds branches with fixed phases. Each RF combiner feeds a detector shown as a diode and a parallel RC load. A single ADC channel samples the detector voltage at each element. The legend identifies the circuit symbols.

g.inkscape:label: Shared sources and element reference phases
